s: FAO is an American toy brand and store. The company opened in 1862 and is renowned for its high-end toys, life-sized stuffed animals, interactive experiences, brand integrations and games.

FAO Schwarz operates a chain of more than 40 high-end toy stores around the United States, with its flagship outlet and headquarters located on Fifth Avenue in New York City. The company is renowned for offering the most exclusive and expensive toys available, but its approach has broadened in recent years to include more mainstream items as well.
